title: Geography
description:
A geography: FIPS key, level and a display name. The name is for display only; it is
never a key and may change spelling between sources.

centroid.description: Centroid in WGS84 decimal degrees, when known (`null` otherwise).

level.description: Must agree with the length of `id` (2 digits = state, 5 digits = county).

provenance.description: Source records for the name and centroid (never empty).

Centroid.description:
A point on the WGS84 ellipsoid in decimal degrees (e.g. a county's population or
geometric centroid; the source states which in its provenance).

GeoId.description: Geography key: state FIPS (2 digits) or county FIPS (5 digits), zero-padded

Provenance.description: Where a number came from: the immutable snapshot, its source URL and when it was retrieved.

licence_id.description: Id of the source's licence or terms as listed in `SOURCES.md`.

sha256.description: Content address of the raw snapshot bytes.

source_id.description: Stable id of the source as listed in `SOURCES.md` (e.g. `cdc-measles-weekly`).

url.description: URL the snapshot was retrieved from.
